style: Archival editorial. Navy field, brass rules, parchment type. The pacing of a title sequence rather than an ad: type sets the promise, the product appears once and is allowed to sit, the numbers land, the mark closes. No bounce, no spin, nothing playful; every ease is power2/power3/sine so the motion reads as considered rather than sold.

customize.note: Hand-authored. The catalog caption blocks assume a bare kinetic-type shot; this piece needs a persistent brass frame, a product screen inset and a three-column stat bank sharing one timeline, so the composition is written directly against the builder contract.
